artifact_observations.location: Red elastic straps and tool handles (center-left)
artifact_observations.reasoning: The red straps exhibit impossible geometry. They appear to fuse into the black handles of the screwdrivers/pliers rather than passing over or under them. Some loops of the strap terminate abruptly or merge with the tool bodies, violating physical occlusion rules.
The claw of the hammer lacks sharp definition and appears slightly melted or warped, blending softly into the background compartment wall.
Metal surfaces lack realistic specular highlights and micro-scratches, appearing overly smooth and plastic-like despite being metal tools.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'red straps'. In AI images, thin overlapping objects like straps often fail to occlude correctly, merging with the objects they cross. Verify if the straps physically sit ON TOP of the tools or if they blend into them. Also, check if the hammer head has a valid physical shape or if it is distorted.
